#en: The data burst you pull from the drifting relay is small, almost an afterthought, but its routing tables tell a different story; every falsified storm report you have seen so far passes through the same chain of freighters and agricultural hubs before vanishing toward a narrow band of coordinates no one files on public charts. It is the first time her adjustments, corporate traffic, and off-the-books shipments all share a single path, and someone took care to list the endpoints only as anonymous grid references, trusting that the pattern itself would go unnoticed. From the prefab in the dust to the dead hunter's fractured log and the altered harvests in the frontier fields, every earlier fragment now reads like a rehearsal for whatever is waiting down that line.
zh: 你从漂流中继站取出的数据束很小，几乎是顺带的，但它的路由表讲述着另一个故事；你迄今见过的每一份伪造风暴报告，都要穿过同一串货船与农业枢纽，随后消失在一片没有任何人在公开星图上归档的狭窄坐标带。\n这是第一次，她的修正、企业交通与账外货运共享同一条路径，而某人小心翼翼地把端点只列成匿名网格引用，指望图案本身不被注意。\n从尘土中的预制房，到死去猎人破裂的日志，再到边境田野里被改造的收成，此前的每一块碎片如今读起来都像是对那条线尽头某种东西的彩排。

#en: The last echoes of the detonation fade, but the traffic map does something no one on any bridge has seen for years: the ghost routes start to unravel. Emergency waypoints flicker, then drop, like someone finally cancelled a standing order no one remembered signing. With that core gone, the invisible hand nudging damaged ships and desperate crews along the same crooked arc has lost its grip.  \nLooking back over the trail, the pattern feels less like coincidence and more like choreography: a nameless cache on a dead world, a derelict patrol hull still obeying half-erased commands, a curated war story with one medic conveniently unaccounted for, all pointing to a system that was still quietly steering the wounded toward somebody who never stopped answering the call.
zh:
爆炸的最后回声渐渐消退，但交通图出现了多年来任何舰桥上都没人见过的一幕：幽灵航线开始散开。
应急航点闪烁，随后熄灭，像有人终于取消了某条没人记得签署过的常备命令。
随着核心消失，那只把受损飞船与绝望船员沿着同一道弯曲弧线轻推的无形之手也松开了。
回望这条线索，图案不再像巧合，而更像一场编舞：一颗死寂世界上无名的藏匿点、一具仍在执行半被抹除命令的废弃巡逻船体、一段被精心编排、恰有一名医护兵去向不明的战争故事，全都指向一个仍在悄悄把伤者引向某个从未停止回应召唤之人的系统。

#en: When the beacon finally unspools its data across the forgotten base's old relays, the path it sketches through the stars no longer looks like random noise but a deliberate slipstream that keeps brushing the same empty coordinates. Whatever ship rode that pattern knew exactly where UC eyes could not follow, and the signal's return address repeats an orbital region that matches hushed talk of burned crews and misjump cases diverted to a single, overworked medical station. So far the trail runs from a corrupted slate on a nameless rock, to falsified manifests in a wandering hauler's hold, to half-erased war sims buried under dust each step hinting that someone has been testing routes at the edges of official charts, then checking the damage somewhere just out of UC jurisdiction.
zh: 当信标终于把它的数据铺展到这座被遗忘基地的旧中继站上时，它在群星间勾出的路径不再像随机噪声，而是一条刻意设计的滑流，一再擦过同一组空坐标。\n无论是什么飞船骑乘着这个图案，它都清楚知道联殖的眼睛无法跟随到何处，而信号的返回地址重复着一个轨道区域，与那些关于被灼伤船员、以及被转入某个超负荷医疗站的错误跃迁病例的低语相吻合。\n截至目前，这条线索从一块无名岩石上损坏的石板，到一艘游荡运货船货舱里伪造的舱单，再到埋在尘土下、半被抹除的战时模拟，每一步都暗示有人一直在官方星图边缘测试路线，然后在联殖管辖之外某处检验损害。

#en: New Atlantis is the comfortable choice, which somehow makes it the most dangerous. If Vector poisoned the numbers at the source, the proof is buried under UC badges, Calyx lawyers, and people who would rather lose a few ships in the frontier than admit they missed a flaw in their own house. Digging there means prying up polished floor panels and forcing bureaucrats to look at what they signed off on.\n\nOut in that strange orbit, the stars do not quite sit where the charts say they should. The lane math bends, splits, then re-joins like it is holding its breath, and every spacer who talks about it lowers their voice as if the void might be listening. If Vector is mapping a fault line through the grav lattice, this crossroads is where his theory stops being rumor and starts becoming a route.
zh:
新亚特兰蒂斯城是舒服的选择，而不知为何，这也使它成为最危险的选择。
如果"向量"是在源头下了毒，证据就埋在联殖徽章、卡利克斯律师，以及那些宁愿在边境损失几艘船、也不愿承认自家房子里有缺陷的人之下。
在那里挖掘，就意味着撬开光洁的地板，逼官僚们直视他们签字批准过的东西。

在那片古怪的轨道上，群星并不完全待在星图所说的位置。航道数学弯曲、分岔，随后又重接，像在屏住呼吸，每个谈到它的太空人都会压低嗓音，仿佛虚空在听。
如果"向量"正在重力晶格中绘制一条断层线，这个十字路口就是他的理论不再只是传言、而开始变成路线的起点。

#en: The underbelly calls first. Neon's damp steel bones are threaded with gossip and off-the-books cartography, every backroom broker convinced they own a private map of who gets through and who disappears. Down there, routes are drawn in favors and fear, not ink. If someone has been steering debtors and haulers into Luc's orbit, the pattern will be etched into those whispered corridors long before it ever reached a ledger.\n\nDeimos is colder, quieter, and somehow more honest. Scrapyard light on dead hulls, manifests clinging to rust because no one bothered to scrub them. If there is proof that escorts and assets were "reassigned" long after the books said otherwise, it will be buried in those frozen paper trails, guarded by professionals who understand exactly what a single surviving stamp is worth.
zh:
下层先发出呼唤。霓虹城潮湿的钢骨里穿织着闲话与账外地志学，每一个密室经纪商都确信自己掌握着一张私密的通行与失踪地图。
在那里，路线是用人情与恐惧画出来的，而非墨水。
如果有人在把债务人与运货船引入吕克的轨道，图案会在它抵达账册之前很久，就刻进那些低语的走廊里。

火卫二更冷、更安静，不知为何也更诚实。废料场的光照在死船体上，舱单黏着锈迹，因为没人费心去擦。
如果有证据显示护卫与资产在账面上早已结清之后很久仍被"重新分配"，它就会埋在那些冻结的纸面线索里，由彻头彻尾明白一枚幸存印章价值几何的专业人士看守。

#en: Neon's underbelly is closer, louder, and filthy with the kind of people Rivet used to drink beside. If anyone sold him a new skin for his ship, it is one of those grease-stained ghosts pretending they never heard his name. Down there I would be trading credits and threats in equal measure, following rumors through back rooms and maintenance shafts, trying not to end up as just another unlogged body under the grating.\n\nThe beacon in orbit is cleaner work, at least on the surface. Just me, vacuum, and a string of forgotten traffic updates that might finally sketch his escape vector in hard numbers instead of bar talk. If those timestamps and altered paths line up with what I already pulled from the yard records and that memorial recording, I will know exactly which way he broke from the lanes when he ran.
zh:
霓虹城的下层更近、更吵，挤满了"铆钉"过去常一起喝酒的那类人。
如果有人给他的船卖过一层新皮，那就是那些满身油污、假装从没听过他名字的幽灵之一。
在那里，我会以同等的分量交易信用与威胁，穿过密室与维护竖井追踪传言，尽量别变成格栅底下又一具无人登记的尸体。

轨道上的信标是更干净的工作，至少表面上如此。只有我、真空，以及一串被遗忘的交通更新——它也许终于能用硬数字而非酒吧闲谈勾出他的逃亡向量。
如果那些时间戳与被篡改的路径，与我已经从船坞记录和那段纪念录音里提取的东西对得上，我就能准确知道他是从哪条航道突围逃走的。

#en: The drift lane where this crate hangs is a blind spot, a thin seam between traffic corridors where automated systems shrug and call missing data a rounding error. That is exactly where a pilot like Vector would let his tracks smear, trusting that conflicting manifests and lazy clerks would hide the shape of his jumps. Whatever is logged against this cargo will show which routes were shaved, which ships appeared where no registered path should have taken them, and which direction he is bending reality next. So far the picture is still half-formed: a half-corrupted slate on a forgotten rock, beacon returns that do not match filed courses, and a Trade Authority hull with waste cycles that belong to a different journey entirely, all nudging the needle toward one name and the unnatural lines he draws through space.
zh:
这个货箱所在的漂移航道是一处盲点，交通走廊之间一道细薄的缝隙——自动化系统在那里一耸肩，就把缺失的数据称作舍入误差。
那正是"向量"这样的飞行员会让自己的踪迹模糊的地方，指望矛盾的舱单与懒惰的文书能藏住他跃迁的形状。
针对这批货物记录下的一切，都会显示哪些航线被削短、哪些飞船出现在任何登记路径都不该带它们去之处，以及他下一次把现实往哪个方向弯折。
截至目前，图景仍只成形一半：一块被遗忘岩石上损坏一半的石板、与申报航线不符的信标回波，以及一具排污周期完全属于另一段航程的贸易管理局船体，全都把指针推向一个名字，以及他在太空中画出的那些不自然的线。

#en: The registry is a scavenger's ledger with its teeth pulled, nothing but serials and decommission dates at first glance, but cross-matched hull IDs and transfer notes show a different story: the same drives, the same controllers, vanishing from official scrapping and reappearing off-books near the same quiet stretch of deep space. Only a ship this forgotten, drifting between ports with no one to vouch for its last cargo, could carry a clean copy of the list before the numbers were massaged for auditors and gossip twisted the details into campfire warnings. So far the trail has been a chain of almosts: an anonymous report from a nowhere outpost, a monitoring shack's glitching readings, a freighter whose jump history did not line up with its manifests, a Neon mechanic hinting at "recycled" parts that never hit the yard.
zh: 这份名录像一本被拔掉牙齿的拾荒者账册，乍看只有序列号与退役日期，但交叉比对的船体 ID 与交接备注讲述着另一个故事：同样的引擎、同样的控制器，从官方拆解中消失，又在深空中同一片安静空域附近以账外方式重现。\n只有一艘如此被遗忘、在港口间漂流、无人为其最后一批货物作保的飞船，才能在数字被为审计员揉捏、闲话把细节扭曲成篝火警告之前，带着这份清单的干净副本。\n截至目前，这条线索是一连串的"差一点"：来自无名哨站的一份匿名报告、一间监测小屋故障的读数、一艘跃迁历史与舱单对不上的货船、一名暗示有"回收"零件从未进过船坞的霓虹城技工。

#en: Buried in the maintenance queue for Neon's lower grid, one tiny block of time repeats with impossible regularity, always tied to the same power sectors and always logged under a rotating list of borrowed credentials. The slot lines up perfectly with drift anomalies flagged by the beacons in this stretch of orbit, suggesting someone has been timing their Grav work planetside to match specific windows in the lanes above. If those schedules are being bent around a single pilot's habits, then the pattern here will tell where he likes to jump from, and when. So far the trail has been a scatter of half-truths and omissions: a misfiled crate tumbling between routes, beacon returns that do not match their courses, and hushed talk in Neon's depths about coils that keep going dark on nights when the same nameless ship slips off the grid.
zh:
埋在霓虹城下层电网的维护队列里，一小段时段以不可能的频率反复出现，总是绑定同样的电力分区，总是在一份轮换的借用凭证下登记。
这个时段与这一带轨道中信标标记的漂移异常完美对齐，暗示有人一直在把地表的重力作业时间安排得与上方航道中的特定窗口吻合。
如果那些时刻表是围绕某个飞行员的习惯被弯折的，那么这里的图案就会告诉他喜欢从何处、何时跃迁。
截至目前，这条线索是零散分布的一半真相与省略：一只在航线间翻滚的错误归档货箱、与自身航线不符的信标回波，以及霓虹城深处关于某些夜晚线圈不断变暗、而同一艘无名飞船悄然脱离网络的低语。

#en: Neon's lower decks are a maze built out of denial and side money. If she is bending patrol nets, the proof is in the hands of dock rats and bookkeepers who know better than to talk loud. Down there I would be trading credits and threats in equal measure, wading through forged manifests and half-truths, hoping someone values survival over silence. It is the softer play, if anything about this chase can still be called soft.\n\nThe tower is different. Clean lines, bad conscience. If I hit that, I am going straight at the people who signed off on this nightmare, not just the ones moving crates. Fractured Phalanx on guard means hardened veterans who already chose a side once and will not hesitate to choose it again. The risk is higher, but so is the chance of ripping out the root instead of just trimming the branches she flies through.
zh:
霓虹城的下层甲板是一座用否认与私钱搭建的迷宫。
如果她在弯折巡逻网，证据就握在码头老鼠与账房手里——他们懂得不该大声说话。
在那里，我会以同等的分量交易信用与威胁，蹚过伪造的舱单与半真半假，指望有人把活命看得比沉默更重。这是更温和的一步棋——如果这场追查还有任何部分能被称作温和的话。

塔则不同。线条干净，良心糟糕。
如果我动了它，我就是直冲那些为这场噩梦签字的人，而不只是搬运货箱的人。
有破碎方阵把守，意味着那些早已选过一边、并会毫不犹豫再选一次的老兵。风险更高，但连根拔起的可能也更高，而非仅仅修剪她穿梭的枝杈。

#en: The first solid threads are knotted up around the Drift-Lane Manifests, and every spacer in Gagarin Landing seems to have a different version of how they vanished, which makes them too important to ignore. On paper they are just cargo and route records, but if someone has been bending safe corridors into killing grounds, the earliest fingerprints will be hiding in those entries, half-lost under corrections and redactions. Until I see how the stories match or fail against the numbers, everything else is just superstition in the bar air. So far all I have are repeated mentions of identical routes flown by ships that should never have shared a path, a handful of captains swearing they felt "pulled" toward the same patch of space, and a lingering rumor about an ex-convoy navigator who always seems to know which way the odds are drifting.
zh:
最初几条结实的线头都缠在《漂流航线舱单》上，而加加林着陆点的每个太空人似乎都有一套关于它们如何消失的不同说法，这使它们重要到不能忽视。
纸面上它们只是货物与航线记录，但如果有人一直在把安全走廊弯折成屠场，最早的指纹就会藏在这些条目里，半消失在修正与涂黑之下。
在我看清那些说法与数字是吻合还是相悖之前，其他一切都只是酒吧空气里的迷信。
截至目前，我手里的只有这些：反复提到由本不该共享同一路径的飞船飞过的相同航线、少数船长发誓他们感到被"拉"向同一片空域，以及一则挥之不去的传闻——某位前运输队领航员似乎总能知道胜算正漂向何方。
